description: This file defines classes and macros for warning reporting and warning categories, including configuration, serialization, and analysis functionalities within a warning reporting system.

classes.name: WarningReportingBoundsCategory
classes.description: Template class managing bounds and analysis for warning categories, including serialization and warning level determination.

classes.name: WarningReportingType
classes.description: Template class representing a warning reporting category with analysis, serialization, and control functionalities.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnitProxy
classes.description: Singleton class acting as a proxy for warning reporting units, managing categories, events, and configuration.

classes.name: ExcludedWarnings
classes.description: Class managing lists of callsigns and modules excluded from warning reports.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Static method to configure bounds or category settings for warning categories.

methods.name: CategoryName
methods.description: Static method returning the name of the warning category.

methods.name: Analyze
methods.description: Method to analyze whether a warning should be reported based on current value and category bounds.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes category data and current value into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into category state.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Converts category state to a string representation.

methods.name: IsWarning
methods.description: Determines if the current value is considered a warning.

methods.name: Enabled
methods.description: Checks or sets whether the warning category is enabled.
